channel.title: The Drill Down: Chicago Bears
channel.description: Weekly NFL matchup scouting reports and win probabilities.

item.title: Week 12: Bears at Lions
item.description: Thu 11/26 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: CHI -2.5 · O/U 55.5 | Model DET 54% vs. market 43% | Chicago's passing game has to exploit a Detroit pass defense ranked 28th in EPA allowed per dropback, and the deep middle is where it can do that, since Detroit allows +0.54 EPA per throw there. Amon-Ra St. Brown draws 28% of Detroit's targets and runs into a Chicago pass defense ranked 5th. Our number puts Detroit at 54% against a market price of 43%, and home field drives most of that gap.

item.title: Week 11: Saints at Bears
item.description: Sun 11/22 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: CHI -11.5 · O/U 49.5 | Model CHI 85% vs. market 82% | The Saints need pressure to slow Caleb Williams and a Chicago passing game ranked near the top of the league, yet New Orleans generates pressure on just 21% of dropbacks. Chris Olave absorbs 26% of New Orleans' targets and runs into a Chicago pass defense that ranks 11th, so his usage matters more than the matchup. Our model puts Chicago at 85%, a bit above the market, and the rushing matchup, worth 5.1 points, drives most of that lift.
